 About Aurora
 Aurora is the AI-native Lifestyle Operating System for the world's highest performers.
A proactive, conversational lifestyle management product relied on by the world's top founders, athletes, and creatives to advise, execute, and manage their travel, dining, wellness, experiences, and gifting globally.
Over half our members use every single day, 95% every week, and in our first 6 months, member spend & engagement is outperforming industry benchmarks by 5×.
Aurora is backed and chaired by Alex Macdonald, the most successful founder in this category, and has raised $12M from experienced operators and tier-1 investors.
We are now expanding the founding engineering team as we scale the product and the member base.
Aurora is built in person from our offices in London, New York, and Los Angeles. The engineering team works from our London office in Belgravia, with flexible remote days.
You can find our recent launch video here.
 The role
 We're hiring an ambitious Backend Engineer to work alongside our CTO and world-class engineering team to build and evolve Aurora's backend systems.
You'll work with the founders, product, and other engineers to design and implement the core infrastructure behind the product. This includes APIs, background processing, agent orchestration, and data pipelines that support proactive, AI-driven behavior.
This is a hands-on role with a high level of ownership. You'll be responsible for taking features from idea to production and for keeping the system reliable as usage grows.
You'll report directly to the CTO. Over time, your role can grow into a broader technical or leadership position as the company scales.
We ship high-polish, high-leverage products to our discerning customer base. We are urgent with our inputs and pragmatic with our outputs.
Many of our early team have ambitions to be founders in the future — we view Aurora as a high-performance startup academy, where you will personally drive the evolution of a high-growth product from its earliest stages.
Join us.
 Our Principles
 We're a deeply committed team of tier-1 backed and exited operators united by our four core principles:
 We seek truth 
 We are high-leverage 
 We are owners
 We believe impossible is an attitude 
 Why Aurora
 High Leverage
 Design a daily-use product placed directly in the hands of the world's most ambitious individuals and organizations - empowering them to compound their time, relationships, and global impact.
 Cutting-Edge AI
 Work hands-on with a next-generation AI system redefining lifestyle management at the highest level, spanning context, recommendation, orchestration, and execution. Design an ultra-lightweight, ultra-high-leverage product experience that consistently wins the engagement, trust, and spend of the most powerful consumer cohort in history.
 Opportunity
 Play a foundational role in building the future of high-performance lifestyle management - a $100bn opportunity at the intersection of technology, luxury, and longevity.
 About The Founders
 Aurora was founded in 2024 by:
 Jonah Lowenstein, previously founder of a social e-commerce platform backed by Accel, 20VC, and the co-founder of Venmo 
 Aurelius Zwick, won the UK's largest youth entrepreneurship competition at age 16
 Dmitry Ogurtsov, previously director of engineering at conversational AI company exited to ZoomInfo
 Aurora is chaired by Alex Macdonald , founder of the world's most successful concierge - exited to Capital One for $300m.
To date, we've raised $12M from Tier-1 VCs and operators, including the founder of Cleo, Quadpay, early investors in Supercell and Deliveroo, the President of VistaJet, and tier-1 athletes including Kevin Love and Kyle Kuzma.
 Requirements
 What you'll do
 Design and build backend services and APIs using Python and Django 
 Own features end to end, from initial design to production rollout 
 Maintain and evolve background processing, agent orchestration, and LLM integrations 
 Work with context-heavy data pipelines and RAG-style systems 
 Operate and improve cloud infrastructure on GCP 
 Improve performance across SQL queries, background jobs, and API endpoints 
 Debug production issues and lead incident resolution 
 Implement secure coding practices and support compliance efforts 
 Collaborate closely with product, curators, and frontend/mobile engineers 
 Review code and help raise the overall technical bar 
 What we're looking for
 Experience
 5+ years building and operating production backend systems 
 Strong, hands-on experience with Python and Django 
 Backend fundamentals
 Deep familiarity with Django and DRF, including common pitfalls 
 Strong SQL skills and experience with schema design and performance tuning 
 Experience with background job systems (ideally Celery) 
 Comfort designing reliable, observable systems 
 Experience working with LLMs or AI infrastructure 
 Exposure to agent-based systems or RAG pipelines 
 Infrastructure
 Experience running cloud-native systems, ideally on GCP 
 Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform 
 Experience operating services in production, not just building them 
 Product mindset
 You care about how systems are used, not just how they're built 
 You think in terms of reliability, latency, and failure modes 
 You're comfortable making trade-offs and explaining them clearly 
 Collaboration
 Able to work closely with product, design, and other engineers 
 Clear communicator who takes ownership and follows things through 
A want to be in-person, near the customer
 Nice to have
 Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001) 
 Basic understanding of frontend or mobile stacks (Flutter, Vue)
 Benefits
$2,000 Tech & Education budget
Complimentary Oura ring or Whoop
Complimentary longevity testing subscription
Lifestyle perks, events, and access opportunities
Full health benefits; 90% coverage, including full dental & vision
Complimentary dinners and evening transport
